name: Signal Cluster S53: Null Detection & Data Quality
description: Tests: is_null(), is_valid(). Warm-up detection, data gap identification, conditional execution guard.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S53: is_null / is_valid
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === WARM-UP DETECTION ===
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
ma_ready = is_valid()(sma_200)

# Only generate signals when MA has warmed up
raw_signal = crossover(close, sma_200)
clean_signal = raw_signal and ma_ready

# === DATA QUALITY ===
has_close = is_valid()(close)
missing_close = is_null()(close)

# === CONDITIONAL EXECUTION ===
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)
both_valid = is_valid()(sma_200) and is_valid()(rsi_val)
combined = where(both_valid, close - sma_200)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='MA Ready (Warm-up)',
    category='Data Quality',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MA Ready', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=static_cast_to_decimal()(ma_ready))

xy_lines(
    title='Close - SMA (guarded)',
    category='Signal',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=combined)
